description: Use this after a Phorme coach has reviewed one of their 1:1 clients, to record today as the review and, if the coach set one, the date of the next check-in. It changes only the coach's own check-in dates for that client.

brain_id.description: The brain id of the coach's own build, for example "cameron".

client_id.description: The client_id of one of the coach's 1:1 clients, from coach_clients.

name: coach_client_reviewed
title: Mark a 1:1 client reviewed
